title: Industrial Designs (General Procedures) Administrative Instructions, No. 3 of 2005
text:
Industrial Designs 1
BELIZE:
ADMINISTRATIVE INSTRUCTIONS
No. 3 of 2005
________
ADMINISTRATIVE INSTRUCTIONS made by the Registrar of Intellectual
Property in exercise of the powers conferred upon him by section 69 of the Patents
Act, Chapter 253 of the Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised Edition 2000.
PART I
PRELIMINARY
Short title. 1. These Administrative Instructions may be cited as the
INDUSTRIAL DESIGNS (GENERAL PROCEDURES) ADMINISTRATIVE
INSTRUCTIONS, 2005.
PART II
RE-REGISTRATION OR RESTORATION
Re-registration 2. Where a registered industrial design has completed its fifth anniversary of
or restoration. registration and at least six months thereafter no application has been made to
renew it, the Registrar shall allow the industrial design to be re-registered or re
stored on the Register, and the provisions of the Act relating to the registration of
industrial designs, including the payment of the relevant fees, shall apply to such
re-registration or restoration, which shall for all purposes be deemed to be a regis-
tration.
PART III
FEES AND FORMS
Fees and 3. The fees to be paid in relation to the relevant applications are those
payment. prescribed in Schedule I.
Schedule I.

2 Industrial Designs
Forms required. 4. The forms required for the relevant applications are those prescribed in
Schedule II. Schedule II.
MADE by the Registrar of Intellectual Property this 7th day of March, 2005.
(ELSON KASEKE)
Registrar of Intellectual Property
